title: SAML assertion clock-skew triggers KMS-unwrap fallback and audit event loss on Private clusters
creator: Aditi Rao
description: Multiple customers on Private clusters reported authentication failures and missing audit events after a scheduled IdP certificate rotation. Root cause appears to be SAML assertions being rejected due to clock-skew-sensitive validation; the control plane then attempted a KMS envelope unwrap fallback which failed intermittently because envelope key metadata did not match the rewrapped key IDs. When KMS unwrap failed, audit events for the affected sessions were dropped into the audit pipeline dead-lettering path and were not surfaced to customer audit logs. This ticket tracks investigation, urgent patch, rollout plan, and post-incident remediation. Affected components: SSO/SAML assertion validation, KMS envelope unwrap/lookup, audit event emitter and DLQ handling in Private control plane.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use Private control plane with IdP that rotated signing key within last 5 minutes
2) Send SAML login flow where service provider receives assertion with NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter near current time
3) Control plane rejects assertion due to strict clock skew check, triggers fallback path that attempts KMS unwrap by envelope key id stored in session metadata
4) If envelope key id was rotated and metadata not refreshed, KMS unwrap returns mismatch error and request ends up failing without audit event being recorded to main audit store
observed_logs: mar 02 10:12:33 controlplane sso: ERROR AssertionValidation - assertion expired by 4s (clock skew threshold 2s)
mar 02 10:12:33 controlplane kms: WARN UnwrapFallback - envelopeKeyId=env-9f3a mismatch for tenant=acct-77
mar 02 10:12:34 audit: ERROR Emitter - failed to enqueue event -> moved to dlq (reason: related session KMS unwrap failure)
impact_summary: Three enterprise customers reported inability to authenticate for short windows (2-7 minutes) during IdP rotations; audit trails missing for those sessions. Business impact includes compliance/regulatory risk and customer escalations to account teams.
mitigation: Immediate mitigation: push config flip to Private control plane to increase SAML clock skew tolerance to 10s for rolling 15-minute window and add a temporary deterministic KMS lookup fallback that tries tenant-specific legacy envelope ids. Communicated workaround to impacted customers to ensure IdP and control plane time sync (NTP).
rollback_plan: If patch causes regressions, roll back SAML tolerance and fallback flags and re-enable strict validation. Rollback includes a coordinated restart of control plane agents in non-overlapping batches to avoid capacity loss.
test_plan: Unit tests for assertion time validation with edge-case offsets
Integration test exercising KMS envelope lookup with rotated and legacy key ids
E2E test: full SAML login flow against staging IdP rotation scenario
Audit pipeline test: ensure events are emitted even when KMS unwrap fails by writing to audit-durable-forwarding path
acceptance_criteria: SAML assertion failures due to clock skew reduced to <0.1% for rotation windows in staging
KMS unwrap fallback path deterministic and returns explicit error that still emits audit event
No regression in other tenants after toggling tolerance flag in canary rollout
Security review completed and patch approved by security team
